title: Malicious code in solblock (PyPI)
description: The solblock package on PyPI versions 0.2.2 and 0.2.3 contains malicious code that executes during installation. It overrides the install command in setup.py to download and run a remote malicious script. The remote repository linked to this package has previously hosted a remote access trojan (RAT) executable and was involved in earlier malicious attempts.
